column3: Close to the Greek; “refuse to believe” renders “are disobedient to.”
BSB renders “pure conduct in fear” as “pure and reverent demeanor.”
BSB adds “your wives” and renders “weaker” as “delicate.”
BSB follows the critical text with “humble” (ταπεινόφρονες); the Textus Receptus reads “courteous.”
BSB follows the critical text without “knowing,” which the Textus Receptus adds.
BSB renders “Do not fear their threats” as “Do not fear what they fear.”
BSB follows the critical text with “Christ as Lord” (Χριστὸν); the Textus Receptus reads “the Lord God.” BSB moves “with gentleness and respect” from verse 16 into this verse.
BSB follows the critical text without “as evildoers,” which the Textus Receptus adds; “with gentleness and respect” is placed in verse 15.
BSB follows the critical text with “you” (ὑμᾶς); the Textus Receptus reads “us.” “Spirit” is capitalized.
BSB follows the critical text with “you” (ὑμᾶς); the Textus Receptus reads “us.” “This water” is supplied.
